search.query: index=* sourcetype="halcyon:alerts" | eval firstSeenEpoch=coalesce( strptime(firstSeen,"%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S.%QZ"), strptime(firstSeen,"%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ") ) | eval lastSeenEpoch=coalesce( strptime(lastSeen,"%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S.%QZ"), strptime(lastSeen,"%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ") ) | eval createdAtEpoch=coalesce( strptime(createdAt,"%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S.%QZ"), strptime(createdAt,"%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ") ) | eval updatedAtEpoch=coalesce( strptime(updatedAt,"%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S.%QZ"), strptime(updatedAt,"%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ") ) | eval completedAtEpoch=coalesce( strptime(completedAt,"%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S.%QZ"), strptime(completedAt,"%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ") ) | eval triage_status=coalesce(triageStatus,status) | eval alert_kind=coalesce(kind,targetKind) | eval alert_action=coalesce(action,recommendedAction) | eval asset_count=coalesce(assetCount,assetsCount) | eval alert_count=coalesce(count,eventCount)
| where isnotnull(triage_status) AND triage_status!="" | stats count by triage_status | sort triage_status
| where isnotnull(alert_kind) AND alert_kind!="" | stats count by alert_kind | sort alert_kind
| where isnotnull(alert_action) AND alert_action!="" | stats count by alert_action | sort alert_action

| search alertId="$tok_alert_id$" offendingSha256="*$tok_sha256$*" triage_status="$tok_status$" alert_kind="$tok_kind$" alert_action="$tok_action$" note="*$tok_note$*" | where "$tok_min_count$"="" OR alert_count>=tonumber("$tok_min_count$") | stats count

| search alertId="$tok_alert_id$" offendingSha256="*$tok_sha256$*" triage_status="$tok_status$" alert_kind="$tok_kind$" alert_action="$tok_action$" note="*$tok_note$*" | where "$tok_min_count$"="" OR alert_count>=tonumber("$tok_min_count$") | stats sum(asset_count) as asset_total

| search alertId="$tok_alert_id$" offendingSha256="*$tok_sha256$*" triage_status="$tok_status$" alert_kind="$tok_kind$" alert_action="$tok_action$" note="*$tok_note$*" | where "$tok_min_count$"="" OR alert_count>=tonumber("$tok_min_count$") | stats latest(updatedAtEpoch) as last_update | eval last_update=strftime(last_update,"%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S UTC")

| search alertId="$tok_alert_id$" offendingSha256="*$tok_sha256$*" triage_status="$tok_status$" alert_kind="$tok_kind$" alert_action="$tok_action$" note="*$tok_note$*" | where "$tok_min_count$"="" OR alert_count>=tonumber("$tok_min_count$") | stats count by triage_status | sort - count
